goals.text: The desktop New Expense form has a Category field, prefilled from the vendor's history, required for business expenses, and Save is ONE request carrying categoryId (no later categorize/confirm).
A suggestion comes from the vendor default, then a learned pattern, then one AI call (>= 0.55) — only a live expense account of this tenant, never suspense, and failure degrades to no suggestion.

POST /expenses books DR chosen category / CR cash in the same transaction (never suspense), refuses a category that is not this tenant's expense account, and learns the vendor's category only from a human's choice.

Mobile Capture prefills the suggested category while the vendor is typed, never replaces a category the person chose, and saves category + categorySource in the single create call; the client degrades to null on any failure.

launch.rollback: Revert the PR. No schema change: AbPattern/AbVendor rows written by the learning path are ordinary vendor memory and stay valid; the plugin UMD bundle reverts with the commit.
